messages:
zara: trying to run the node quickstart; first generation call fails 502 while the console shows 'Provisioning workspace' indefinitely. anyone seen this?

kevin: yes—if workspace creation returns 202 pending, the auth layer blocks calls until billing webhook confirms. SDK currently retries fast on 401 which makes the error noisy.

zara: sample logs: `POST /v1/workspaces -> 202 {id: "wk_live_77", status: "pending"}` then `auth refresh failed (401)` and `request error 502`.

infra-bot: incident 2026-03-23T16:40:00Z - billing webhook delivery backlog causing pending workspaces (backoff job queued=wkb_221)

kevin: two fixes: infra should improve webhook retries; SDK should detect create->202 then treat immediate 401/502 as transient and backoff longer with jitter.

docs: quick mitigation: update quickstart to poll workspace status before attempting first call and show a friendly spinner + message. will add snippet to README.

maria: added a tiny polling helper to the sample app (tries GET /v1/workspaces/{id} with exponential backoff up to 20s) and it reduced new user blockers in staging.

zara: re-ran after 3m and it worked. please add console hint and SDK telemetry for this race so we can measure frequency.

kevin: filed SDK ticket #8321: onboard_pending detection + telemetry tag + backoff policy (1s, 2s, 5s). assigning to auth team.

docs: PR incoming to show the polling snippet and troubleshooting blurb in the quickstart guide.

infra-bot: deploy 2026-03-23T16:48:12Z - webhook retry patch rolled out
